messages:
maria: Quick sync — drafting a compact qualification checklist for design partners for the Q3 beta of the Dedicated routing policy. Goal: 12 partners, 6-week feedback loop, prioritized infra/latency/edge-case tests. Thoughts?
kevin: 👍 need to capture throughput baselines and production-like traffic patterns. Also note GPUs available for private deployments.
olivia: We should include a short pre-survey for partner usage patterns (seq len, concurrency, percent streaming) — 3 questions max.
ashley: Agree. Also clarify data-sharing limits. Some partners will require strict KMS/no-logs. Add checkbox in qualification.
jordan: For checkins, propose weekly 30m + a short async health form every 48h. Sync cadence can relax after week 3 if signals stable.
maria: Good — proposal: qualification gates: 1) minimum monthly requests >10k or clear high-value workflow; 2) commit to feature-flag integration; 3) ability to run basic eval harness. Green/amber/red gating.
kevin: Add "ability to run a canary" — we need partner capacity to test rollouts under canary traffic.
olivia: Success criteria for beta: latency within 1.5x of baseline for 95p, no regression in top-3 prompt families, and actionable qualitative feedback from at least 8 partners.
maria (edited): Also define compensation: credits + priority support. Keep it simple.
ashley: What about NDAs and IP? Legal needs a short one-pager saying logs for eval only, retention 30 days, anonymized.
kevin: I'll draft a minimal infra checklist and a sample canary config snippet:
```
canary:
  traffic_split: 5%
  duration: 72h
  metrics: [latency_95, error_rate]
```
olivia: Nice. For feedback loop tooling: we should send a structured report template partners fill weekly — include example prompts, failures, and suggested model behavior.
maria: Next steps: Kevin + Olivia + Legal to draft qualification + canary + NDA. I'll create a short sign-up form and candidate scoring sheet. I'll share first draft tomorrow. cc: @dp-bot to create a tracking board.
dp-bot: created board 'partner-pipeline-1852007890' and added 12 slots. :robot_face:
maria: thx everyone — let's review tomorrow 10:30 PT. If anyone wants to pre-review, drop comments in the doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/partner-beta/qual-checklist
kevin: I'll add perf benchmarks to the doc tonight.
ashley: I'll ping Legal to speed review.
olivia: I'll draft the 3-question intake survey and share.
jordan: Scheduling note: if we recruit enterprise partners, extend the cadence to 8 weeks and add a monthly exec review.
maria: noted. end.
